scenes.title: Why Are You Running?
scenes.summary: Outside KBS, a documentary cameraman stops rookie producer Baek Seung-chan as he sprints late toward his induction ceremony, while Tak Ye-jin accidentally dings a parked sedan in the lot.
scenes.location: outside the KBS building and staff parking lot

scenes.title: Why Seung-chan Joined Variety
scenes.summary: After the induction ceremony, Seung-chan tells the cameraman how giving his mother his first paycheque made the job feel real, then admits he joined the variety department to work near a college senior he likes.

scenes.title: The Original Kim Tae-ho
scenes.summary: Chief producer Kim Tae-ho greets the rookie producers, insists he had the name before MBC's famous producer, squeezes five days of training into one day, and plugs his own book that Seung-chan bought by mistake.

scenes.title: Ratings Charts and Show Tickets
scenes.summary: Tae-ho guides the rookies around the variety floor, calling the morning ratings sheet a producer's report card and showing how to refuse Gag Concert ticket requests from day one.

scenes.title: Four-Thousand-Won Cafeteria Lunch
scenes.summary: At the KBS staff cafeteria, Tae-ho praises the cheap meal tickets and industry gossip, then brags that he is close friends with visiting pop stars who actually have no idea who he is.

scenes.title: Door Ding and Jindo Dog Alert
scenes.summary: Music Bank producer Tak Ye-jin vents to junior producer Ryu Il-yong about scratching an imported sedan on her way in; Il-yong warns Tae-ho and Seung-chan with the office alert code Jindo Dog Level Three.

scenes.title: Hey, Polka-Dot Tie
scenes.summary: When Seung-chan's phone rings during her briefing, Ye-jin scolds him for not setting it to vibrate and tells him a producer must not apologize too easily, while wondering why the car owner has not read her text.

scenes.title: Caught on the Studio Crane Camera
scenes.summary: While demonstrating camera angles and the overhead crane in the empty studio, Ye-jin and the rookies spot Ra Joon-mo and assistant producer Shin Hye-joo sitting closely together in the stands.

scenes.title: Just a College Junior
scenes.summary: Seung-chan greets his crush Hye-joo in the corridor, realizes she barely remembers his school club or neighbourhood, and retreats to the men's restroom where Joon-mo grumbles about the documentary camera.

scenes.title: Heading to the Broadcast Commission
scenes.summary: Joon-mo pushes his afternoon team meeting to four o'clock as he heads out to the Broadcast Standards Commission.

scenes.title: Fifteen Boogers at Dinnertime
scenes.summary: At the Broadcast Standards Commission, Joon-mo explains why every producer dreads a summons and apologizes to a stern commissioner after his show aired a crude word fifteen times during family dinner hours.

scenes.title: The Crew Knows Last
scenes.summary: Outside the hearing room, entertainment reporter Kang teases Joon-mo with rumours that his show is being cancelled and warns him that the production crew is always the last to hear.

scenes.title: Geoje Island Is Too Far
scenes.summary: In a flashback to his revamped outdoor show with veteran actresses, Youn Yuh-jung refuses to travel to Geoje Island or sleep outside in the cold, and Joon-mo admits ratings have hit rock bottom.
scenes.location: outdoor shoot set and interview room

scenes.title: Never Film on Jeju Island
scenes.summary: Back in the meeting room while the head writer is still crossing Mapo Bridge, Joon-mo rejects writer Son Ji-yeon's Jeju Island pitch as a bad omen and boasts that one phone call to Ye-jin will clear Miss A's schedule.

scenes.title: Protect Your Own Rice Bowl
scenes.summary: Right after lecturing the rookies on saying no to favours, Ye-jin flatly turns down Joon-mo's speakerphone request to pre-record Miss A, leaving Joon-mo embarrassed just as Director Jang summons him.
scenes.location: Music Bank hallway and 2 Days & 1 Night room

scenes.title: Everyone Knew Except Joon-mo
scenes.summary: Variety Director Jang In-pyo and CP Kim Tae-ho confront Joon-mo over his 5.7 percent ratings and tell him the current cast run is ending, news the whole department already knew.

scenes.title: Am I Getting Fired Too?
scenes.summary: Joon-mo asks Tae-ho if he is losing his post too; Tae-ho tells him to assemble a new cast immediately and combine tomorrow's anniversary dinner with the farewell party, which Joon-mo compares to a lonely wake.

scenes.title: A Quick Photo in Cindy's Waiting Room
scenes.summary: After Director Jang mentions that his teenage daughter is a fan of K-pop star Cindy, Tae-ho drops into Cindy's waiting room before the live broadcast and awkwardly brings the girls in for a photo.
scenes.location: Director's office and Cindy's waiting room

scenes.title: Cindy Refuses to Change Outfits
scenes.summary: Irritated by the long wait, Cindy spars with her road manager over rehearsals and refuses to change out of her sheer stage outfit, prompting Ye-jin to march down to her dressing room.
scenes.location: Cindy's waiting room and backstage corridor

scenes.title: Isn't This Outfit Pretty?
scenes.summary: In the dressing room, Cindy insists her outfit is pretty rather than racy, corners rookie Seung-chan into agreeing, and threatens to pull out of the broadcast until Ye-jin clears the room.

scenes.title: A Jacket Over the Outfit
scenes.summary: Alone with Cindy, Ye-jin flatters her into wearing a jacket on stage, then steps outside to boast and catches Seung-chan in a comic loop where he can neither apologize nor stay silent.
scenes.location: Cindy's waiting room and backstage hallway

scenes.title: Live Broadcast Chaos
scenes.summary: During the live Music Bank broadcast, Cindy tosses off the agreed jacket on air and leaves the building at once, leaving a furious Ye-jin to vent at exhausted first-day rookie Seung-chan.

scenes.title: Feed Her Before She Performs
scenes.summary: Joon-mo spots Cindy's road manager buying a tiny diet snack for her dinner, buys hot gimbap and fish-cake soup at a street stall for her instead, and leaves Cindy puzzled in her van.
scenes.location: convenience store, street snack tent, and Cindy's van

scenes.title: It Is My Father's Car
scenes.summary: Ye-jin finally reaches the scratched sedan's owner in the dark parking lot, discovers it is rookie Seung-chan driving his father's car, and hears he will get a proper repair estimate first.

scenes.title: Why Are You Buying Us Korean Beef?
scenes.summary: At a Korean beef restaurant, Joon-mo's writers immediately suspect bad news from the expensive menu; Joon-mo explains only the cast is changing and promises none of the writers are being dropped.

scenes.title: Don't Bother Me Tonight
scenes.summary: After an exhausting day at the station, Ye-jin and Joon-mo cross paths at home and warn each other not to pick a fight tonight.

scenes.title: A Family Full of Prestigious Titles
scenes.summary: Over a late-night celebration cake, Seung-chan's father leads a rambling family prayer calling KBS state television and proudly counts his son's producer title among prestigious professions.
